description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dutugemunu, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520802
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, ownership details, and land registration particulars. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in Type 4 classification criteria.
